items.author: Dana Kowalczyk
items.title: PSA kids ibuprofen from Cedarbrook Pharmacy
items.body:
PLEASE READ if you bought childrens ibuprofen liquid at Cedarbrook on Erin Mills Pkwy. My son ended up in emerg last night because he got DOUBLE the dose. I used the syringe in the box exactly like it says. Turns out there is a RECALL and nobody called me, nobody told me anything when I bought it. How is this ok?? Check your medicine cabinets. I'm so angry I can't even. #ErinMills #Mississauga

items.author: quality@corvane-pharma.example
items.title: VOLUNTARY RECALL - Pediatric Ibuprofen Oral Suspension 100 mg/5 mL - dosing device
items.body:
Dear Pharmacy Partner,

Corvane Pharma Inc. is voluntarily recalling the oral dosing syringe supplied with Pediatric Ibuprofen Oral Suspension 100 mg/5 mL (berry), 120 mL bottle, lots CV6114A and CV6114B (exp. 08/2027).

Issue: a printing error on the syringe barrel. Graduations are labelled at half their true volume (the mark labelled 2.5 mL measures 5 mL; the mark labelled 5 mL measures 10 mL). A caregiver following the label will give approximately twice the intended dose.

The suspension itself meets all specifications. It is not contaminated and is not affected by this recall.

Actions: stop dispensing these lots with the supplied syringe. Advise customers to discard the supplied syringe and use a correctly marked oral syringe. Replacement syringes will ship via your distributor. Customers may also return product for a full refund.

Caregivers concerned about an overdose should contact a poison centre or physician.

Corvane Quality Assurance

items.author: Rania Haddad
items.title: Corvane recall - our numbers
items.body: Lots CV6114A + B came in Oct 20 shipment. OTC sold since then: 31 bottles (POS report). Pulled remaining 9 from shelf Nov 7 morning. OTC sale = no patient profile, no phone number for most. Sign on front door + by kids aisle. Contact the local poison centre.
